sloka: उपानृत्यंश्च राजानं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः ।बालाश्च रूपवत्यश्च स्त्रियः पानवशानुगाः ।। ७.४२.२० ॥
transliteration: upānṛtyaṁśca rājānaṁ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ ।bālāśca rūpavatyaśca striyaḥ pānavaśānugāḥ ।। 7.42.20 ॥

translations.english: Servants quickly brought food for Rama's meal, and those skilled in dance and song performed before the king.
